semantic_families.semantic_intent: Select applicable fixed/rental and unit-rate combinations for a specified recurring usage, excluding unnecessary tariffs or dominated packages. Simple independent comparisons are not a dependent procedure.
semantic_families.confidence_contribution: Billing task plus explicit usage profile, larger rate inventory and repeated charge components.

semantic_families.semantic_intent: Extract an underlying rule or map a new situation onto it, not recover the author's conclusion or copy argument topology.
semantic_families.confidence_contribution: Requested-operation feature; corroborated by propositional options and learned exemplars.

semantic_families.semantic_intent: Evaluate the prospective effect of a proposed fact on the existing argument's support, not describe its existing flaw or infer a supported conclusion.
semantic_families.confidence_contribution: Intent feature only when an argument target and intervention task agree.

semantic_families.semantic_intent: Combine multiple journey delays or clock/reference offsets to derive an arrival or elapsed time.
semantic_families.confidence_contribution: Procedural domain and multi-stage structure; not time vocabulary alone.

semantic_families.semantic_intent: Compose a chain of spatial relations to determine the necessary direction or configuration; mere directional vocabulary is insufficient.
semantic_families.confidence_contribution: At least two explicit relational constraints plus a requested derived consequence.

semantic_families.semantic_intent: Test possible/necessary outcomes under a bounded calendar or arrangement rule system; not true/false wording in an argument.
semantic_families.confidence_contribution: Possibility task with independently detected repeated/bounded constraints.

review: Initial semantic rubric reviewed against real matched questions; not official gold labels.

discovered_boundaries.name: Principle extraction is not argument analogy
discovered_boundaries.description: Identifying, stating or matching an underlying general rule belongs with applying that principle; matching premise/conclusion topology is different.

discovered_boundaries.name: Prospective impact versus warranted inference
discovered_boundaries.description: Challenge/cast doubt evaluates additional information only when the task targets argument strength; supported by/concluded from asks for an inference.

discovered_boundaries.name: Structured non-numerical procedures
discovered_boundaries.description: Composing directional constraints and simulating bounded calendars can require a procedure without digit-heavy stems. Combine temporal stages/offsets rather than keying on a clock alone.

discovered_boundaries.name: Usage-conditioned tariff comparison
discovered_boundaries.description: A fixed usage profile selects applicable rental/unit-rate combinations from a larger tariff table. Independent cost comparisons alone are not a non-trivial dependent procedure; tier/packing constraints can still justify both skills.

discovered_boundaries.name: Selecting a percentage reference base
discovered_boundaries.description: Parallel answers describe competing denominators/years for the same percentage. Identifying the relevant reference population is selection; a single ratio check does not by itself create a dependent procedure.

discovered_boundaries.name: Geometric composition not yet covered
discovered_boundaries.description: Tile feasibility, pane packing and intersections are not mere viewpoint equivalence. Earlier static-property selection labels need review until material selection versus configuration recognition/construction is justified.

discovered_boundaries.name: Analogy overrides flaw vocabulary
discovered_boundaries.description: Another argument with an analogous defect is structure mapping, not diagnosis of the original defect.

discovered_boundaries.name: Representation equivalence versus a dynamic procedure
discovered_boundaries.description: Recognise the same shape under folding, reflection, rotation or a viewpoint change as Identifying Similarity. Computing a changing state, quantity or path remains procedural; selecting among options alone is not Relevant Selection.
discovered_boundaries.modality: visual or structurally described spatial task

discovered_boundaries.name: A table need not introduce irrelevant data
discovered_boundaries.description: Ribbon purchasing and medal proportions use procedural setup; redundant race columns materially require selection.

discovered_boundaries.name: Incomplete dual-skill support requires review
discovered_boundaries.description: Do not drop an indispensable construction merely because filtering has stronger learned support.

discovered_boundaries.name: Information sufficiency versus explanatory calculation
discovered_boundaries.description: Algebra may justify which data is sufficient without making the requested answer a computation.

rulebook_refinements.semantic_intent: Choose the scenario's applicable ratio/profile and reference entry instead of raw magnitudes. All candidate rows may be inspected without making the information-basis choice incidental.
counter_evidence: mere numerical closeness without an applicability/basis decision
rulebook_refinements.refinement: Clarifies that candidate screening/measure selection is not limited to discarding entire rows.

rulebook_refinements.semantic_intent: Construct a schedule satisfying person totals and consecutive-duty limits.
positive_evidence: request for a feasible named-person schedule
counter_evidence: argument truth rather than schedule feasibility

rulebook_refinements.semantic_intent: Quantise complete units, join entity-specific rates and derive comparable totals.
counter_evidence: irrelevant rates are the real challenge

rulebook_refinements.semantic_intent: Infer a nested-layer dimension formula including repeated opposite edges and unequal margins.
Match the requested relationship/statistic across data, graph, container-shape or symmetry representations.
positive_evidence: alternative visuals or a defined representation mapping
rulebook_refinements.refinement: An explicitly specified statistic such as pairwise differences may be prepared routinely before recognising its equivalent graphical encoding; this is not the creation of an independent dynamic state.

rulebook_refinements.semantic_intent: Construct conserved entity-level balance changes from multiple directed transfers, then test possible initial/final states.
counter_evidence: graph presence without a transfer process

rulebook_refinements.semantic_intent: Convert category-specific priced revenue to counts, then match the resulting proportions to a visual.
counter_evidence: only selection of applicable tariffs is material

patterns.name: Recover the author's existing principal claim
patterns.description: Identify the claim the author is defending, not a new inference or a supporting reason.

patterns.name: Infer a warranted new claim
patterns.description: Derive what the given information supports, rather than restating an existing main claim.
patterns.cognitive_task: Determine an implication warranted by the premises.

patterns.name: Find the unstated necessary bridge
patterns.description: Identify a missing premise required to connect the stated evidence and conclusion.
patterns.cognitive_task: Identify what must hold for the reasoning to work.

patterns.subcategory: Assessing the Impact of Additional Evidence
patterns.name: Change the support for an argument
patterns.description: Assess how a new fact strengthens or weakens the inference; both directions share this category.
patterns.cognitive_task: Evaluate the effect of an additional premise.

patterns.name: Diagnose an invalid reasoning step
patterns.description: Describe what goes wrong in the original inference, not another argument with that structure.
patterns.cognitive_task: Locate and characterise a defect in the inference.

patterns.name: Transfer an argument topology
patterns.description: Choose another argument with the same premise/conclusion relation, including an analogous flaw.
patterns.cognitive_task: Map the original argument's relational structure onto a different argument.

patterns.name: Instantiate an abstract normative rule
patterns.description: Extract a principle and find the new situation to which that rule applies.
patterns.cognitive_task: Apply an abstract rule to a new concrete case.

patterns.name: Filter material data or diagnostic properties
patterns.description: Selecting relevant rows, conditions or spatial properties materially reduces the information needed; routine arithmetic alone is not a separate procedure label.
patterns.cognitive_task: Select the relevant information/properties from a larger set.

patterns.name: Construct a dependent calculation or rule process
patterns.description: Build or execute dependent steps, a constraint construction, repeated rule, backward schedule or transformation. A table can supply the setup without requiring Relevant Selection.
patterns.cognitive_task: Determine and execute a non-trivial procedure.

patterns.name: Recognise structural correspondence across representations
patterns.description: Recognise an equivalent configuration or relationship under folding/unfolding, rotation, reflection or viewpoint change, or transfer an abstract quantitative method. Mere visual resemblance or choosing an option does not establish equivalence.
patterns.cognitive_task: Map invariant relationships/configurations across representations rather than construct a new sequence or filter irrelevant data.
